title: Tests for the v3 Resume repair gaps: Releasable arm end to end, ReconcileRetained commit-failure rollback, settings-reset skip for a bind-only head, remote issued/ready branches
outcome: Tests for the v3 Resume repair gaps: Releasable arm end to end, ReconcileRetained commit-failure rollback, settings-reset skip for a bind-only head, remote issued/ready branches
acceptance: A test drives a public Resume on an interrupted head with no wire intent and begins recorded (the Releasable arm) and asserts that the dispatch generation is bumped and the head is admitted afresh.
A test makes the commit of the ReconcileRetained transition fail and asserts that recovered_admission and routing_token are restored.
A test shows the session_crud settings-reset skip applies to a bind-only head with no evaluate, and that a later cancel leaves the session able to bind again.
The remote 'issued' and 'ready' status branches of the reconcile step each have a test of their own, not only the lost-bind and lost-evaluate replay test.
cargo test --bin termal passes with the new tests.
